title: Bookmarked: News Stories On Our Reading List
title_cn: Bookmarked: News Stories On Our Reading List
summary: Bigfoot leaves a paper-trail, the gas prices in GTA VI, splitting the Bloomin Onion bill on a date, the board games people cheat at the most, and evidence of cheating on our very show: Join hosts David Gura, Christina Ruffini and Lisa Mateo on Bloomberg This Weekend for Bookmarked, where they share stories that caught their attention over the past week. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: By The Way: Headlines You May Have Missed
title_cn: By The Way: Headlines You May Have Missed
summary: A gift of GTA VI coming with a contract, what that SNL ‘Sister’ sketch says about American healthcare, Robert Pattinson as Bond, and the F1 aspirations of children: Join Lisa Mateo, David Gura and Christina Ruffini for a roundup of headlines you may have missed, but gotta see. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Rahm Emanuel Says Trump Is Playing Into China’s Hands
title_cn: Rahm Emanuel Says Trump Is Playing Into China’s Hands
summary: Former US Ambassador to Japan Rahm Emanuel tells Bloomberg This Weekend that he is seriously considering a 2028 presidential run as he lays out an economic vision focused on reforming capitalism, combating corruption and strengthening the middle class. Speaking with hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini, Emanuel also criticizes President Donald Trump’s approach to China and Russia, arguing that the US should work more closely with allies to counter Beijing and protect American economic and national security interests.  (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Yardeni Cuts S&P 500 Target Again, Says Bear Market Is Unlikely
title_cn: Yardeni Cuts S&P 500 Target Again, Says Bear Market Is Unlikely
summary: Wall Street strategist Ed Yardeni cut his S&P 500 Index year-end forecast for the second time in about two months in the wake of a powerful stock selloff that pushed the benchmark into a technical correction.

title: Investors Brave Stock Market ‘Fragility’ as AI Trade Falters
title_cn: Investors Brave Stock Market ‘Fragility’ as AI Trade Falters
summary: The stomach-churning selloff that rocked equities has options traders girding for more volatility ahead.

title: Storm Devastates Rural Brazilian Town in Threat to Crops, Lives
title_cn: Storm Devastates Rural Brazilian Town in Threat to Crops, Lives
summary: A heavy storm that hit Brazil’s southern state of Rio Grande do Sul on Friday devastated a small town and raised concerns that continued rains and strong winds may bring further damage to crucial agriculture areas.

title: GTA VI Takes Over Thanksgiving Week
title_cn: GTA VI Takes Over Thanksgiving Week
summary: On Bloomberg This Weekend, Bloomberg reporter Josyana Joshua tells host Lisa Mateo how the long-awaited release of Grand Theft Auto VI is becoming a cultural and workplace phenomenon, with gamers taking time off and preparing to play through Thanksgiving week. Joshua explains how the game’s 13-year buildup is driving demand for consoles and gaming gear while potentially competing with family gatherings, football and other holiday entertainment. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Fed’s Inflation Fight May Require More Hikes
title_cn: Fed’s Inflation Fight May Require More Hikes
summary: Neil Dutta, head of US economic research at Renaissance Macro Research, tells Bloomberg This Weekend that the Federal Reserve made a mistake by holding rates steady in October and may need multiple hikes as inflation remains stubbornly above its 2% target. Speaking with hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini, Dutta says the recent market selloff does not yet signal broader economic trouble, arguing that AI investment and a resilient labor market continue to support growth even as the Fed has less flexibility to cushion falling markets. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Governors Push States to Lead on AI
title_cn: Governors Push States to Lead on AI
summary: On Bloomberg This Weekend, Governors Wes Moore, Spencer Cox, Josh Stein and Mike Braun tell host Christina Ruffini that states need to take a larger role in shaping AI and data center policy as concerns grow over electricity costs, water use, jobs and consumer protections. The bipartisan group says data centers should largely pay for their own energy needs and emphasizes local control, while differing over how aggressively the federal government should regulate AI. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Strong Earnings Prove No Match for the Crumbling AI Trade
title_cn: Strong Earnings Prove No Match for the Crumbling AI Trade
summary: For years, a strong earnings season has given Wall Street something to fall back on. But the crumbling artificial-intelligence trade has ripped away that support.

title: Oil Shock Response Sets Emerging-Market Bond Winners and Losers
title_cn: Oil Shock Response Sets Emerging-Market Bond Winners and Losers
summary: Fuel subsidies are driving a widening divide in emerging markets, with investors favoring bonds from nations that have taken the painful steps to curb them.

title: Why Your Health Insurance Keeps Getting More Expensive
title_cn: Why Your Health Insurance Keeps Getting More Expensive
summary: The average employer-sponsored family health plan now costs more than $28,000 a year, about the price of a new car, and premiums are expected to climb even faster in 2027. As costs rise, more of the bill is coming out of workers’ paychecks, and health care has become a top budget concern for CFOs.  (Source: Bloomberg)

title: S. Korea Rolls Out Phased Measures to Stabilize Stock Market
title_cn: S. Korea Rolls Out Phased Measures to Stabilize Stock Market
summary: South Korea announced phased measures to calm markets amid rising volatility, including ensuring a stock stabilization fund is in place to respond when needed, top financial officials said after an emergency meeting on Sunday.

title: Trump’s Asia Trip Leaves Key Issues Unresolved
title_cn: Trump’s Asia Trip Leaves Key Issues Unresolved
summary: ABC News State Department reporter Shannon Kingston tells Bloomberg This Weekend that Russia’s increasingly provocative actions near NATO countries are complicating President Donald Trump’s push for a negotiated end to the war in Ukraine, while Moscow remains publicly defiant. Speaking with hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini, Kingston says Trump’s Asia trip produced few concrete results and puts greater pressure on the upcoming G20 meetings to deliver progress on China, trade and other unresolved diplomatic issues. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Taiwan Mulls Lowering Margin Requirement to Support Stock Market
title_cn: Taiwan Mulls Lowering Margin Requirement to Support Stock Market
summary: Taiwan is considering lowering the margin requirement ratio for stock investors using borrowed funds as it tries to stem a selloff after the benchmark equity index’s worst week in 35 years.

title: Asia’s Stock Rescue Efforts Gather Pace After Wall Street Plunge
title_cn: Asia’s Stock Rescue Efforts Gather Pace After Wall Street Plunge
summary: Asian authorities are stepping up efforts to stem a deepening stock-market rout, with China easing margin requirements, and Taiwan and South Korea rolling out intervention measures following Friday’s plunge in US equities.

title: From Squeezes to Meltdown, a Week of Mayhem Rocks Metals Markets
title_cn: From Squeezes to Meltdown, a Week of Mayhem Rocks Metals Markets
summary: As the copper industry gathered in Shanghai last week, Grace Li was struck by the overwhelmingly bearish mood over the outlook for demand. She agreed with the pessimism. In fact, she came close to pulling out her phone on the spot to put on a short position after her Monday conversations.

title: China’s $1.7 Trillion AI Rout Turns Hot Trade Into Losing Bet
title_cn: China’s $1.7 Trillion AI Rout Turns Hot Trade Into Losing Bet
summary: China’s AI stock trade, once a hot bet as the nation’s technology powerhouses raced to catch up with the US, has morphed into a losing strategy.

title: Russian Cargo Ship Attacked by Drones in Gulf of Finland
title_cn: Russian Cargo Ship Attacked by Drones in Gulf of Finland
summary: Russia said a cargo ship bound for its Kaliningrad exclave was targeted in international waters in the Gulf of Finland, highlighting growing risks to the country’s energy and food exports through critical Baltic Sea shipping routes.

title: How AI is Accelerating Cyberattacks
title_cn: How AI is Accelerating Cyberattacks
summary: The number of cyberattacks spiked in 2020 and has remained elevated since, posing a threat to the businesses, infrastructure, and critical systems we depend on. Experts say AI has played a role in both accelerating attacks and defending against them, but it gives criminals the upper hand. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Apple’s AI Agent War, Early 2027 Product Plans and iPhone Duo Face Unlock Review
title_cn: Apple’s AI Agent War, Early 2027 Product Plans and iPhone Duo Face Unlock Review
summary: Also: The company prepares a slew of new iPhones, iPads and Macs for early 2027.

title: Nvidia Board Faces a Governance Reckoning
title_cn: Nvidia Board Faces a Governance Reckoning
summary: On Bloomberg This Weekend, Bloomberg opinion columnist Gautam Mukunda tells hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini that Jensen Huang’s departure from Nvidia has exposed broader corporate governance problems, as the board faces outside pressure to bring him back while investigations and potential shareholder litigation loom. Mukunda argues that Silicon Valley’s tendency to concentrate power around founder CEOs can weaken oversight, while Huang’s exit also complicates the debate over whether the US should allow advanced Nvidia chips to be sold to China.  Nvidia has publicly said its board does not intend to reinstate Huang as CEO. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Tech Outages Fuel a New Prepping Boom
title_cn: Tech Outages Fuel a New Prepping Boom
summary: Bloomberg senior cybersecurity reporter Jordan Robertson tells Bloomberg This Weekend that a wave of network failures resembling the effects of a major cyberattack was instead self-inflicted, exposing risks from aging infrastructure, interconnected systems, staffing cuts and the rapid adoption of AI. Speaking with hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini, Robertson explains why the disruptions are fueling renewed interest in doomsday prepping while cautioning that a prolonged cyber catastrophe remains unlikely. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Governors Call for Federal AI Rules Without Sidelining States
title_cn: Governors Call for Federal AI Rules Without Sidelining States
summary: A bipartisan group of US governors is urging Washington to set rules for the most powerful artificial intelligence systems while allowing states to protect consumers, workers and children from the technology’s risks.

title: Tower Records Becomes Latest Japan Retailer Hit by Data Breach
title_cn: Tower Records Becomes Latest Japan Retailer Hit by Data Breach
summary: Music retailer Tower Records Japan Inc. said customer information was leaked following unauthorized access, making it the nation’s latest retailer to disclose a data breach.

title: China Objects to US Curbs on Telecoms’ Access to Phone Numbers
title_cn: China Objects to US Curbs on Telecoms’ Access to Phone Numbers
summary: China urged the US to withdraw a measure barring its three largest telecoms from directly obtaining US phone numbers, saying the action violates principles of nondiscrimination and fair competition.

title: Australia Spy Chief Warns of Data Center, AI Risks, Age Reports
title_cn: Australia Spy Chief Warns of Data Center, AI Risks, Age Reports
summary: Australia’s spy chief said that data centers and artificial intelligence risk exposing the nation to foreign interference and malicious state actors, according to an interview in The Age Sunday.

title: Crowdstrike’s Talks With Zscaler Show AI-Led Cyber Consolidation
title_cn: Crowdstrike’s Talks With Zscaler Show AI-Led Cyber Consolidation
summary: A wave of multibillion-dollar takeovers is reshaping the cybersecurity industry as the biggest companies race to expand their defenses against increasingly sophisticated attacks powered by artificial intelligence.

title: US Probing Alleged Spy Tied to Ex-Nvidia CEO, Spy Chief Says
title_cn: US Probing Alleged Spy Tied to Ex-Nvidia CEO, Spy Chief Says
summary: Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton said Nvidia Corp. is a perpetual target for people trying to illegally obtain its high-end chips and the US is investigating an alleged Chinese spy who had an affair with the company’s former chief executive.

title: Russian Attacks on Energy Cites Strain Ukraine Power Supply
title_cn: Russian Attacks on Energy Cites Strain Ukraine Power Supply
summary: Russia’s defense ministry said its forces struck several targets in Ukraine overnight, including a power station, port infrastructure facilities and a cargo ship, according to a statement on Telegram.

title: Van Hollen Says He Has Momentum in Bid to Lead Senate Democrats
title_cn: Van Hollen Says He Has Momentum in Bid to Lead Senate Democrats
summary: Senator Chris Van Hollen pressed his bid Sunday to replace Chuck Schumer as leader of the incoming Democratic Senate majority, arguing that the party needs new leadership to deliver on the economic promises that helped it win the midterm elections.

title: Strongman’s Son Nominated for Premier of Bosnia’s Serb Entity
title_cn: Strongman’s Son Nominated for Premier of Bosnia’s Serb Entity
summary: The son of Bosnian Serb strongman Milorad Dodik, who until last year, along with his father, was subject to US sanctions for corruption and siphoning of public funds, has been nominated as the next prime minister of Republika Srpska, one of two entities that make up Bosnia-Herzegovina.

title: Democrats, Republicans Eye the 2028 Field
title_cn: Democrats, Republicans Eye the 2028 Field
summary: Democratic strategist Ravi Gupta and Republican strategist Leslie Shedd tell Bloomberg This Weekend that the 2028 presidential race remains wide open as both parties assess the lessons of the midterms and potential candidates begin defining their messages. Gupta, founder and CEO of The Branch, and Shedd, president of Rising Communications, tell hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini that affordability will remain central to both parties while Democrats weigh investigations of the Trump administration and Republicans reconsider their messaging after their midterm losses. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Rep. McCaul Seeks Answers From Jensen Huang
title_cn: Rep. McCaul Seeks Answers From Jensen Huang
summary: Republican Congressman Michael McCaul tells Bloomberg This Weekend that he wants answers from Nvidia’s Jensen Huang about the company’s chip sales and whether advanced AI technology reached China in violation of US export controls, amid scrutiny of Huang’s relationship with a woman accused of ties to Chinese intelligence.  Speaking with hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini, McCaul also says Vladimir Putin is an adversary rather than a US friend, calls for investment to strengthen vulnerable federal technology systems and urges Republicans to learn from their midterm losses as he prepares to leave Congress. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Eastern Libya Says Blast on Russian Ship Likely Due to Attack
title_cn: Eastern Libya Says Blast on Russian Ship Likely Due to Attack
summary: Eastern Libyan authorities said an explosion on board a Russian ship docked at Benghazi’s naval base early Sunday was likely due to an attack by “unmanned vehicles.”

title: Trump Tests Common Ground With Democrats
title_cn: Trump Tests Common Ground With Democrats
summary: Bloomberg White House correspondent Hadriana Lowenkron tells Bloomberg This Weekend that President Donald Trump may look for areas of cooperation with a Democratic-controlled Congress after the midterms, including credit card interest rates, health care and immigration. Speaking with hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini, Lowenkron also explains how the White House is responding to recent aviation infrastructure problems as affordability and other domestic concerns take on greater political importance. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: US Power Advantage Over China Shrinks Further on Iran War Effect
title_cn: US Power Advantage Over China Shrinks Further on Iran War Effect
summary: The advantage the US has over China in influencing the course of international events has shrunk to the smallest level since 2018, with the Iran war and unilateralism undermining its military and diplomatic strength, according to a new report.

title: ICE Arrest at Airport Prompts Outcry From Officials, Politicians
title_cn: ICE Arrest at Airport Prompts Outcry From Officials, Politicians
summary: An arrest by federal immigration agents at Seattle-Tacoma International Airport sparked outrage among officials and politicians Saturday, and intensified scrutiny of Immigration and Customs Enforcement as Democrats prepare to take control of Congress and investigate the agency’s tactics.

title: FDA Leadership Search Includes Cancer Care CEO, RFK Jr. Adviser
title_cn: FDA Leadership Search Includes Cancer Care CEO, RFK Jr. Adviser
summary: The Trump administration is considering Sara Brenner, a senior adviser at the Department of Health and Human Services, and Jeff Vacirca, head of a New York oncology group, for leadership positions at the Food and Drug Administration as the FDA’s top ranks undergo another shakeup, according to people familiar with the matter.

title: Trump Orders Contractors to Get Signoff for Congress Queries
title_cn: Trump Orders Contractors to Get Signoff for Congress Queries
summary: President Donald Trump issued an executive order requiring federal contractors to notify the White House of any congressional requests for their communications, as the White House prepares for inquiries when Democrats take over Congress in the new year.

title: Mexico Arrests Sinaloa Drug Kingpin on FBI Most Wanted List
title_cn: Mexico Arrests Sinaloa Drug Kingpin on FBI Most Wanted List
summary: Mexican security forces arrested one of the FBI’s 10 most-wanted fugitives, a suspected drug trafficker accused of smuggling narcotics into the US for more than two decades.

title: French Protests Draw Fewer People After Government Concessions
title_cn: French Protests Draw Fewer People After Government Concessions
summary: French protests over the cost of living, wealth inequality and shortfalls in the education system drew fewer people on Saturday than in previous weeks, after the government offered concessions including a boost to the minimum wage and pledged to invest in schools and universities.

title: Brazil’s Jair Bolsonaro Admitted to ICU With Obstruction
title_cn: Brazil’s Jair Bolsonaro Admitted to ICU With Obstruction
summary: Former Brazilian President Jair Bolsonaro was admitted to an intensive care unit with an acute intestinal obstruction after being hospitalized with severe abdominal pain, according to a statement from the hospital on Saturday.
